description: FastAPI application defining REST API endpoints for a local-first notes management system, including CRUD operations, search, tags, favorites, and versioning features.

classes.name: NotesFlow
classes.description: Handles core note operations such as create, read, update, delete, and search.

classes.name: NoteVersionsFlow
classes.description: Manages versioning of notes, including save, list, and restore operations.

methods.name: _flow
methods.description: Creates a new NotesFlow instance with a fresh database connection.

methods.name: _versions_flow
methods.description: Creates a new NoteVersionsFlow instance with a fresh database connection.

methods.name: health_check
methods.description: Performs a health check of the service.

methods.name: list_notes
methods.description: Lists notes with optional filtering by tag and favorites.

methods.name: create_note
methods.description: Creates a new note with provided title, content, and tags.

methods.name: get_note
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its ID.

methods.name: delete_note
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID.

methods.name: search_notes
methods.description: Searches notes by query, with optional tag and favorites filtering.

methods.name: list_tags
methods.description: Lists all tags with usage counts.

methods.name: set_favorite
methods.description: Sets the favorite status of a note.

methods.name: save_note_version
methods.description: Saves a manual version snapshot of a note.

methods.name: list_note_versions
methods.description: Lists all saved versions of a note.

methods.name: restore_note_version
methods.description: Restores a note to a previous version snapshot.
